assessment: This paper is useful for researchers in the field of enteric neuroscience and peripheral nervous system development. The single cell RNA-sequencing based analysis of the developing chicken ENS, demonstrates differential cell identity contribution from the sacral and vagal neural crest and influence of the local distal embryonic environment for final differentiation. A basic classification scheme of neuronal cell types in the chicken combined with analysis of a more mature embryonic stages and functional data will however be needed in the future to determine the role of differential stem cell origin for final neuronal composition in the distal gut of chicken.
